_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround long {width}x{height} grid.
Yu bilong player {player_id}. Muvmnt i orait: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Objektiv: yu no mari, ol i dai. Trai i kilim; hitim wal i kilim; krash hedin i kilim tupela.

board.after_moves: Plak i go long narapela taim: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Man {player_id} i dai long wanem em i no bin mekim wanpela move.

outcome.survived_win: Man {player_id} i stap laip; olgeta narapela man ol i pundaun.
outcome.all_crashed: Olgeta man i paitim ol samting long wankain taim.
outcome.outlived: Man i winim ol narapela long pait.
outcome.turn_limit: Taim man i winim mak bilong tanim, em bai win.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Laik ol i go daun, ol grup bilong ranking (best→worst): {groups}
